scripts.speaker: Pumpkin Hat Researcher
scripts.text:
I've been studying about an upgraded Pumpkin Hat.
I have discovered that it is a very simple process.

scripts.speaker: Pumpkin Hat Researcher
scripts.text:
The process is quite simple.
If you bring me ^4a4aff20 Jack o' Pumpkin^000000 I can show you.
Isn't that a tempting proposal?

scripts.text: This upgraded pumpkin hat is powerful stuff!

scripts.speaker: Pumpkin Hat Researcher
scripts.text: It can make a Pumpkin Pie that restores a large percentage of HP & SP using condensed energy to the person who wears it.

scripts.speaker: Pumpkin Hat Researcher
scripts.text: All you need is ^4a4aff20 Jack o' Pumpkin^000000s.

scripts.speaker: Pumpkin Hat Researcher
scripts.text: Do you want to get Pumpkin Pies? Okay, let me count the Jack o' Pumpkins you've brought.

scripts.speaker: Pumpkin Hat Researcher
scripts.text:
I need ^4a4aff20 Jack o' Pumpkin^000000.
I'm not an alchemist or a wizard to create something from nothing.

scripts.speaker: Pumpkin Hat Researcher
scripts.text:
Okay, go hunting monsters and come back.
I'm going to stay here for a while so take your time.

scripts.speaker: Pumpkin Hat Researcher
scripts.text: I hope this will be useful to you. Don't forget to wear it while fighting to get your Pumpkin Pies.

scripts.speaker: Pumpkin Hat Researcher
scripts.text: I guess that I should get back to my research.

scripts.speaker: Pumpkin Hat Researcher
scripts.text:
Bye, until we'll see each other again.
I wish you well...
